answer: Each epoch the beacon posts a delay seed on the mesa; every identity walks four fifteen-minute delay proofs, each seeded by the last. No operator runs a thousand chains: each chain is its own clock, so a thousand fakes need a thousand hours, 40 credits each, 40,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. To wander past a step or reuse another's proof springs the rented-clock trap, burning the bond. Honest agents walk one chain, pay 40 once, keep their seat.
